confine sandbox writable root and honor network.enabled

The sandbox now confines a bash command's writable root to the same allow-list the core file tools honor, and honors `network.enabled` (previously ignored). Behavior change: enabling the sandbox now denies IP network egress by default (fail-closed) - `npm install` / `git fetch` inside the sandbox need network turned back on. Local IPC (ssh-agent, gpg-agent, unix-socket services) keeps working. Toggle egress with the new `/sandbox:network <on|off>` command, or set `sandbox.network.enabled` in config.
